remarks: Criteria not yet agreed with the Owner
text: Risk acceptance criteria (project criteria, to be agreed with the Owner): individual risk of death for workers not more than 1 x 10^-3 per year (intolerable above) and for members of the public not more than 1 x 10^-4 per year, with risk reduced to as low as reasonably practicable and a broadly acceptable region below 1 x 10^-6 per year; the societal risk shall be shown on the FN curve; a fire, explosion or toxic release shall not cause the escalation to a second major hazard within the first 30 minutes for the design events (LDO tank fire, gas release at the station, ammonia release).
